property_summary: For any target address and value, calling sendMoney with a callee whose fallback may revert must never change contract C's balance in the reference (the reference never reverts callers when the callee fails), whereas the mutant which requires the callee call to succeed will revert for failing callees and thus the observable success/failure differs for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace the external call with a call that forwards all gas and requires success, making failures revert instead of being ignored.
